configuration.cache: local-only; 4096 entries; SSR TTL 3600s; miss harness TTL -1s
configuration.cache_miss_policy: SSR store expires immediately; category model cache remains warm
configuration.local_outbox_collection: full stdout capture using existing provided-runner API after retaining original truncation failure
configuration.mojo_requests: at least 100 total; at least 10 per client

limitations: Shared runners and a colocated load generator give comparative CI evidence, not production capacity.
Local Apple M4 run with ordinary desktop activity; not an isolated production server.
Source is the exact committed tree; concurrent uncommitted UI changes are excluded.
Supplementary socket and service corpus suites have distinct datasets and generators; their throughput is not interchangeable.
Shared runner and load generator share the host; values are comparative evidence, not production capacity.
wrk uses closed-loop fixed connections and corrected latency histograms; in-flight concurrency is not measured.
RSS is end-of-sample manager+workers residency, not peak; PostgreSQL and generator resources are separate.
Cache hits/misses verified by probes; warmed worker-local SSR cache; cache miss uses harness-only expiry policy.
Only anonymous GETs; migrations, seed and rate-limit accounting write only the dedicated disposable database.
